Home / Rules & Privacy
Policies

Rules & Privacy

The core competition rules, our cheating policy, and how we handle participant data.

Competition rules

Each participant may submit only once per round. Late submissions are not accepted except in documented cases of technical failure. Certificate details (name, school, city, date of birth) must be entered correctly at registration, since they are used for every certificate issued.

In the Qualification Round only, participants may work with friends or classmates; the Semi-Final and Final Round must be completed entirely alone, under supervision. Violations can result in disqualification from the current and future editions.

Privacy & data

We collect the information needed to run the competition and issue certificates: name, school, contact details, and exam results. Essential cookies keep the site functioning; optional analytics and marketing cookies are only used with consent, adjustable at any time from the cookie preferences on this site.

To request a copy of your data, ask a correction, or raise a privacy concern, contact us using the details on the Contact page.
